name: nrf51822
description: Nordic nRF51822 (Cortex-M0, 16 MHz, 256 KB flash, 32 KB RAM, 2.4 GHz radio): GNU Arm toolchain with the nRF5 SDK 12.3 (MDK headers, CMSIS start-up, linker script), Renode nRF51 models

toolchain.notes: Bare-metal programs use the SDK's MDK (#include "nrf.h"); tools/nrf51/tests/periph.c in the Renode tree is a register-level example. SDK examples build with their own Makefiles: tools/nrf51/examples/build_examples.sh (GCC 13 / newlib 4 adjustments).

image.notes: load the ELF ({kind: elf}). With a SoftDevice, load its HEX too (components/softdevice/s130/hex/s130_nrf51_2.0.1_softdevice.hex); the MBR at 0 starts the SoftDevice, which starts the application at 0x1B000.

renode.notes: Run with 'emulation SetGlobalQuantum "0.00001"' (start-then-WFE code such as an ADC conversion otherwise misses its wake-up). Pins: 'gpio0 PinLevel <n>', 'gpio0 RecordPin <n>' then 'gpio0 PinEdges <n>'; buttons on the DK are active low: 'gpio0 OnGPIO 17 false' presses, 'true' releases; 'gpio0 Wire <from> <to>' makes a jumper. Analog: 'adc SetVoltage <AIN 0-7> <V>' (also LPCOMP's inputs), 'adc Vdd <V>', 'temp Temperature <C>'. UART: 'uart0 CreateFileBackend @file true', input 'uart0 WriteChar <byte>'. TWI devices: 'machine LoadPlatformDescriptionFromString "lm75: Sensors.LM75B @ twi0 0x48"' (also Sensors.MMA7660); SPI: one device per spi0/spi1, 'spi0 CsPin <n>' names its chip-select GPIO; SD card: 'machine SdCardFromFile @img spi0 <size> false "sd"'. SYSRESETREQ and the watchdog reset the chip keeping flash and RAM; System OFF wakes on a GPIO DETECT. Erased flash/UICR read 0xFF. Docs: tools/nrf51/README.md and PERIPHERALS.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the nRF5 SDK 12.3 peripheral examples (tools/nrf51/examples/run_examples.py, examples.txt) and tools/nrf51/tests/periph.c
